text:
marie: FYI I'm hitting pod IP exhaustion when scaling the gke-prod gpu nodepool in us-east1. Trying to spin up 24 A100 nodes and a bunch of training pods but kube-scheduler failing with IP assignment errors. Can someone open quota/IP range requests with GCP?

aj: Which quotas exactly? GPUs per region, VPC secondary range size, or Compute IPs? Any error text from the node bootstrap?

marie: Error from kubelet logs: "Failed to allocate IP for pod: no available addresses in secondary range". Cloud console shows the cluster using VPC-native (alias IP) with a small secondary range for the node pool (10.4.0.0/20). We need at least /18 to support target scale. Also we bump into GPUs quota for A100 in us-east1 — current GPU quota is 16, need ~96.

aj: OK. Two parallel asks then: (1) Request GPU quota increase (A100) for project:redwood-prod in us-east1. (2) Expand or add secondary IP range for the subnet used by the cluster (or create a new nodepool that uses a bigger secondary range). For GCP quota raises use Console -> IAM & Admin -> Quotas, filter by "GPUs" and "In-use IP addresses", then Edit Quotas.

clara: Another option: create a separate nodepool in a different subnet with its own secondary range sized for GPUs only. Less blast radius and avoids changing the existing cluster CIDR. :+1:

aj: Here's a minimal support ticket template I can paste into GCP (copy/edit as needed):

```
Project: redwood-prod (projects/123456789012)
Region: us-east1
Request: Increase GPU quota (A100) from 16 -> 96 in us-east1.
Rationale: Scheduled ramp for training fleet for Q2 infra tests. We expect sustained usage of ~60-80 GPUs across the region during tests; need quota for node provisioning and CI.
Also request increase of "In-use IP addresses" by 2048 in region us-east1 to allow expanding alias ranges for existing GKE cluster gke-prod.
Impact if not approved: Cannot provision required GPU nodepools; autoscaling will fail causing job backlogs and customer/regression test delays.
Contact: marie@redwood.com, aj@redwood.com
Deadline: 2026-04-05 (soft)
```

sandeep: Heads-up on the GKE/CNI side: with VPC-native clusters the max pods per node is bounded by the size of the node-pool secondary range (each node carves a subrange). If you change the secondary range CIDR, you must ensure it doesn't overlap other ranges. We can either: expand the existing secondary range (risky if other clusters share it), or create a new secondary range and add a new nodepool that references it.

sandeep: Example command to add a new secondary range and update subnet: (run from gcloud with org permissions)

```
# create a new secondary range on subnet
gcloud compute networks subnets update redwood-subnet-us-east1 \
  --region=us-east1 \
  --add-secondary-ranges=gke-gpu-secondary=10.8.0.0/18

# then create nodepool that uses that secondary range
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-large 
  --cluster=gke-prod 
  --region=us-east1 
  --node-taints=cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator=A100:NoSchedule 
  --accelerator=type=nvidia-tesla-a100,count=1 
  --node-labels=workload=gpu 
  --subnetwork=redwood-subnet-us-east1 
  --node-ipv4-cidr=10.8.32.0/23 \
  --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=40
```

marie: Nice. I'll avoid touching the existing pool to be safe.

aj: I'll file the GCP quota ticket now with the template above and request the subnet secondary-range addition. Will ask for expedited review (we're mid-sprint).

quota-bot: Ticket created: GCP-45678 — Quota increase request (GPUs A100 + In-use IPs) for project redwood-prod in region us-east1. ETA 48-72 hours. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas/requests/GCP-45678

marie: Thanks @aj and @sandeep. Action items: aj -> follow up on GCP ticket, create new nodepool once subnet secondary range is provisioned; sandeep -> prep nodepool creation command and verify CIDR allocations; clara -> confirm CI job scheduling once nodes up. I'll update the runbook and post back here. :thumbsup:

aj: Will update the thread with ticket progress.

clara: Also add note about cost estimate — A100s are expensive. We should pin expected spend for the test window in the ticket (approx $X/day per node).

marie: Will add cost numbers to the ticket before send.

aj: done, added approximate cost + ask for quota increase.

quota-bot: Support update GCP-45678: GCP requested more info — please provide expected peak number of concurrent GPUs and job duration.

marie: Replying with: peak 80 concurrent GPUs, median job duration 6-8 hours, repetitive for a 2-week test window.

last note - thanks everyone, will close once nodes are green.
